quests.title: The Flamingo Census
quests.summary: The Environmental Centre is counting this winter's flamingos and needs a hand: catch a Brineling, then face the Flamingo Warden.

steps.text: Catch a Brineling on the shore of the Akrotiri Salt Lake and show the Centre Warden.
The Flamingo Warden wants a fair match at the lake. Win it.
Report back to the Centre Warden at the Environmental Centre.

quests.reward: A Flamingo Feather (a Speed charm), three Halloumi, two Loukoumi and standing with the Overseas Territories.
